Looking for a motivated, curious and energetic architect-in-training to joining our quickly expanding team based in Los Angeles, CA. Ideal candidate has 3-5 years of Revit experience working in both renovation work and ground-up construction. Role will be to assist the Project Manager / Architect in coordination of plans with consultants, government agencies and other 3rd party professionals. Must take pride in their work, be excited to help build and shape an emerging company and have interest in working on a variety of project types at any given time (adaptive reuse, office, hospitality, food service and automotive technology).
Ideal Program experience: Revit, Adobe CS, Enscape
